GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 684 (10 Jun 48) GC/TNG
(SCAPIN - 1907)
APO 500
10 June 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Misawa Air-to-Air Gunnery Range.
1. The rectangular over-water area whose corners are located at the points designated by the following coordinates, is designated as an air-to-air aerial gunnery range:
40° 34' north - 142° 01' 15" east
40° 39' 38" north - 142° 23' east
40° 06' 30" north - 142° 14' east
40° 12' north - 142° 35' 15" east
2. The inhabitants of the ports on the eastern coast of the island of Honshu south of 40° 45' north latitude, and north of 40° north latitude, will be notified prior to each actual use of this range. When the range is used for periods in excess of fifteen (15) days, warning reminders will be disseminated to the inhabitants concerned. This information will be forwarded through Military Government units to local Japanese civil authorities.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
